findings.detail: Description of "check_request" is 13190 chars, far longer than this server's median (2260). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ask_seller, check_request, confirm_receipt, message_seller, pay_order, preview_refund, request_refund, search_offers, submit_return_shipment, withdraw_order · Private data: ask_seller, check_request, message_seller, pay_order, quote_order, request_refund, search_offers · Public sink: ask_seller, check_request, message_seller, pay_order, preview_refund, request_order, request_refund, search_offers, submit_return_shipment · Destructive: pay_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ask_seller, check_request, confirm_receipt, message_seller, pay_order, preview_refund, request_refund, search_offers, submit_return_shipment, withdraw_order · Private data: ask_seller, check_request, message_seller, pay_order, quote_order, request_refund, search_offers · Public sink: ask_seller, check_request, message_seller, pay_order, preview_refund, request_order, request_refund, search_offers, submit_return_shipment · Destructive: pay_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "ask_seller" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
